title: ClockWerx
overview:
A completely new type of puzzle game where your fingertip skill at pressing the button with good timing is what counts. Even while it frustrates you, we guarantee you'll find yourself hooked before you know it.

As you'd expect from Alexey Pajitnov of Tetris fame, 50 richly varied stages won't let you get bored until the very end.

In addition to the normal stage-clear mode, there is a versus mode where two players fight fiercely over items at the same time, plus a "stage editor" that lets you create your own original rounds. Fully loaded!

タイミング良くボタンを押す指先テクがモノを言う、全く新しいタイプのパズルゲーム。イライラしながらも、いつの間にかハマっちゃうことうけあいです。

さすがは"テトリス®"のアレクセイ・パジトノフ。バラエティーに富んだ50面ものステージが、キミを最後まで飽きさせない。

通常の面クリアモードに加え、2人同時に熱くアイテム争奪戦を繰り広げる対戦モード、さらに、自分だけのオリジナルラウンドが創れる"面エディタ"も搭載で充実さ満点!
